description: This Java class defines a tenant-specific tracing configuration used in a larger application, including properties for sampling modes and device-specific overrides, with methods for setting and retrieving these values.

classes.name: TenantTracingConfig
classes.description: A Java class representing configuration settings for tenant-specific tracing, including sampling modes and device overrides.

methods.name: getSamplingMode
methods.description: Returns the default sampling mode for the tenant, or null if not set.

methods.name: setSamplingMode
methods.description: Sets the default sampling mode for the tenant and returns the instance for chaining.

methods.name: getSamplingModePerAuthId
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable map of device-specific sampling modes, where device tokens override the default.

methods.name: setSamplingModePerAuthId
methods.description: Sets the device-specific sampling modes, replacing existing entries, and returns the instance for chaining.

methods.name: getSamplingMode
methods.description: Returns the sampling mode for a specific device, or the default if not set, or null if neither is set.
